description:
Welcome to Joy Dean Designs, where creativity meets organization! We specialize in beautifully crafted pre-made bullet journals, planners, and downloadable templates designed to inspire, organize, and delight. Each product is thoughtfully created to bring a perfect balance of functionality and artistry to everyday life. By joining our affiliate program, you’ll be partnering with a brand that values quality, creativity, and sustainability. 

Our star product, "The Enchanted" Premium Edition, is an 8"x10" pre-made bullet dotted journal designed for 2025. It features:

  • A black linen hard cover with pink foil stamping.
  • Pink coil binding for a unique touch.
  • Monthly tabs for easy navigation.
  • A pocket in the inside back cover.
  • A pink ribbon bookmark and a black elastic closure.
  • Monthly themes, habit and mood trackers, and creative pages.
    This journal is perfect for anyone seeking an elegant, ready-to-use solution for bullet journaling without the time commitment of designing from scratch.

  • Pre-Made Convenience: Offers the creativity of bullet journaling without the setup time.
  • Luxury Design: Premium materials, including a black linen cover, pink foil accents, and elegant features like tabs and a ribbon bookmark.
  • Eco-Friendly: A tree is planted with every journal sold.
  • Exclusive Appeal: Limited availability for the premium edition adds a sense of exclusivity.

  • Affiliates earn 10% commission on every sale made through their unique affiliate link.
  • Payments are made monthly via PayPal, provided the minimum payout threshold of $20(CAD) is met.
  • Affiliates can track their sales and commissions in real-time through our affiliate dashboard.

  • Affiliates will receive exclusive access to marketing materials, including high-quality images, banners, and suggested captions to promote our products.
  • Regular updates on new product launches, promotions, and campaigns to keep your audience engaged.
  • Customer satisfaction is a top priority. All products are backed by a high standard of quality and service, making them easy to promote with confidence.
  • Perfect for bloggers, influencers, and content creators in the lifestyle, productivity, or creative niches.
